svg.title: The hydrogen spectrum
svg.desc: Hydrogen’s spectral lines on a linear wavelength scale from 0 to about 1900 nm. The Lyman series (n_f = 1) lies between 91 and 122 nm in the ultraviolet. The Balmer series (n_f = 2) runs from 365 to 656 nm, with its longest line, from n_i = 3, at 656 nm. The Paschen series (n_f = 3) runs from 820 nm to 1875 nm, its longest line coming from n_i = 4. Each series crowds together toward its short-wavelength limit.
